name: SeedanceAI
tagline: Independent AI video creation from text, photos and reference media
description: SeedanceAI is an independently operated third-party AI video website, not affiliated with ByteDance or Seedance. It offers text-to-video, image-to-video and reference-media workflows for creators making short clips, product visualizations and social content. Users choose output settings, check credit costs and download generated MP4 files. Paid subscriptions and one-time credit packs are available; one-time packs start at $9.90. Generation quality varies and source media must be used with permission. The website provides a browser-based workflow rather than requiring a local video editing installation. Users should review current generation costs and the terms for their intended use before starting a project.
